about_title: 👋 What I bring to your business
achievement1_problem: Lack of proper testing approach in startup - tests were inefficient and expensive, product quality was low in some areas.
achievement1_solution: Developed appropriate testing strategy at organization level and test plans for specific projects - this increased testing efficiency and organized junior work, resulting in real quality gains.
achievement2_problem: Need to migrate from AWS cloud provider to DigitalOcean due to excessive costs.
achievement2_solution: Prepared proper plan with risks and their mitigations. Testing went smoothly - only 1.5 weeks of testing compared to a similar project in the past that took a whole month!
achievement3_problem: Improper git repository management caused numerous issues with test environment management and release execution.
achievement3_solution: Identified the problem and proposed implementing proper environment format and branch/change management using gitflow.
achievement4_problem: No time to onboard into project, but urgent production testing needed.
achievement4_solution: Developed so-called guided exploratory testing for the project, where experience-based techniques could be applied without test cases and application knowledge.
achievement5_problem: A lot of testing required for platform provider migration.
achievement5_solution: Managed interdisciplinary and distributed teams to prepare test environment, tested it and successfully released on production migrating platform with over 700,000+ active users.
achievement6_problem: A 100% vibe-coded project accumulated critical quality degradation: growing regression across key functional areas and mounting technical debt that threatened the product's stability and scalability.
achievement6_result: Regression reduced, technical debt minimised in core modules
achievement6_solution: Shifted from unstructured AI prompting to a structured context-file approach: created detailed context documents per feature area to guide AI-assisted development precisely. Systematically reduced regression in core functional areas through targeted test coverage, and tackled technical debt by refactoring critical modules, separating concerns and stabilising the codebase.
achievement7_problem: No AI adoption in the project: the team did not use AI in its daily work, and team throughput stayed at around 30 tasks a month.
achievement7_result: Over 4x higher productivity: from 30 to 130 tasks a month, at a fraction of the added cost
achievement7_solution: We analysed and documented how the team actually works and identified the company's available resources. Building on solutions from Anthropic, OpenRouter and open source, we created our own AI framework with numerous workflows, plus a basic AI harness for every team member.

service_ai_desc: Implementing tailored AI solutions and intelligent agents to automate complex decision-making and enhance productivity.
service_ai_quality_desc: Testing AI-powered products (RAG, chatbots and agents): evaluation datasets, hallucination and accuracy checks, prompt-injection and guardrail testing, and regression testing after model or prompt changes.
service_automation_desc: Streamlining workflows with intelligent automation solutions, reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency.
service_data_desc: Validating data pipelines end to end: source-to-target reconciliation, transformation and business-rule checks, data quality (completeness, duplicates, schema drift) and automated regression of ETL jobs and reports.
service_relations_desc: Running projects from requirements to release: planning, prioritisation and risk control, clear stakeholder communication, and aligning technical and QA work with business goals.
service_security_desc: Conducting security audits, infrastructure validation, and performance testing to ensure robust, scalable, and secure applications.
service_strategy_desc: Designing comprehensive testing strategies and building test pipelines tailored to project needs and requirements, organizing QA processes, and leading teams toward quality excellence and business objectives.
service_testing_desc: A holistic approach to product quality: combining manual and automated testing, verifying that business requirements are correctly understood and delivered, and catching gaps before they reach users.
